I am Hindu on the "ROAD" with an upper-caste surname so that I don't have to deal with people and the police unnecessarily.

Unfortunately, for FEMALES, changing religion won't give them the "ability to walk freely." 

So, religion has NO REAL UTILITY in public spaces and on roads.

A Hindu surname is very helpful for females in the corporate world to avoid prejudice, as confirmed by the "Sukhdeo Thorat Report"

But we don't consider women autonomous entities (as per LORD MANU), so they largely need to operate within controlled networks.

So, practicing atheism is nearly impossible in India currently.

BUT

Being an atheist is possible.

If being a theist means believing that there exists a GOD, and being a theist requires prioritizing "morality" over "convenience" all the time, then we are all atheists, we just don't admit it publicly.

As per my understanding, there is no cure for BIGOTRY  ..
